title: Only 11% Can Pass This Firefighter Entrance Exam
summary: Fire science, tools, hazards and fast incident decisions test how clearly you think under pressure.

landing.intro: Fire behaviour, hazard spotting, mechanical reasoning and split-second judgement. Can you stay calm when every clue matters?

about.body:
This worldwide entertainment challenge explores entrance-level firefighter reasoning across 40 varied questions. It covers fire and smoke science, scene hazards, equipment mechanics, practical numeracy, spatial awareness, clear communication and incident judgement.

The five exam sections become progressively more applied, moving from accessible station foundations into changing fire clues, practical mechanics, competing hazards and a final integrated alarm. Questions use worldwide-safe principles rather than local ranks, codes, building rules or operational firefighting procedures.

Your final percentage reflects only the answers given in this entertainment quiz. It is a playful snapshot of the entrance areas that felt strongest and the topics that proved more challenging, not a judgement of operational readiness or suitability for firefighter employment.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Work through each exam section at your own pace; there is no timer or speed bonus.
Choose the single option best supported by the visible clues. Correctness stays hidden until the final reveal.
Keep going as the decisions become harder, then reveal your score and complete answer review.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This is not an accredited firefighter entrance exam, employment assessment, fitness test, qualification, operational training course or source of emergency advice. Fire-service procedures vary worldwide; always follow local emergency services and qualified professional guidance.

profile-1.title: The Entrance Exam Standout
profile-1.copy: You combined excellent fire-science foundations with calm, evidence-led judgement across the entire entrance challenge. Changing hazards, mechanical clues and communication details stayed clear even when the final alarm became demanding.

profile-2.title: The Sharp Incident Thinker
profile-2.copy: You showed a strong feel for the science, mechanics and safety reasoning behind the challenge. Most of the exam's hazard, calculation and prioritisation traps did not pull you off course.

profile-3.title: The Calm Incident Solver
profile-3.copy: You handled a broad mix of fire behaviour, practical mechanics and multi-clue decisions with steady reasoning. A few finer observation and communication details kept the entrance challenge interesting.

profile-4.title: The Steady Crew Candidate
profile-4.copy: You built a solid result by following visible evidence and treating safety seriously. Your strongest area shows where your entrance-exam thinking became most assured.

profile-5.title: The Promising Recruit
profile-5.copy: You solved a good share of the assessment and showed useful instincts across several entrance areas. The answer review will reveal which foundations are ready for another look.

profile-6.title: The First-Alarm Explorer
profile-6.copy: The assessment uncovered some knowledge gaps, but it also found moments of thoughtful, safety-first judgement. Every reviewed answer is a fresh chance to strengthen the foundations behind calm incident thinking.

firefighter-s1q1.question: Heat and fuel are present. Which third element is needed to complete the fire triangle?
answers: Water
Oxygen
Smoke
Ash

answers: Step through the water to switch it off
Pour more water over the panel
Move the panel by its outer case
Keep people clear and alert qualified responders

answers: No; smoke appearance can be affected by several conditions
Yes; every material always produces one unique colour

30 metres
35 metres
40 metres

Use the west exit and continue to the assembly point

answers: Tape the crack and use it once

Ask someone to hold the connector
